title: fugaro access grants (Realtime Database node config/admin/access)
description: The role and scope pairs, at the Realtime Database node config/admin/access (D1585, docs/roles-scopes). Each grant names a member, a role and the scope the role is held at; a person may hold several pairs, so the document is a list rather than a map keyed by member. The scope is stored as the string a person types — `project`, `all-repos`, or a comma-separated list of canonical repository patterns — so the reader re-validates it with the same grammar that admitted it. Unlike a CLI document, this schema is closed (additionalProperties is false at both levels) because the Go reader is strict too: internal/access decodes with DisallowUnknownFields, so a node carrying a field the reader does not know is refused rather than ignored, and a field that is added here without a reader change is a node every installation would halt on. The node is under config/admin, whose `.read` and `.write` are false: no client token reads it, and the CLI reaches it over IAM (F22, F28).

grants.description: The stored role and scope pairs, in the order they were written. The cap is internal/access.MaxGrants.

user.description: The member, in the canonical `user:<address>` form internal/access.Member builds: the local part byte for byte and the domain lower-cased. A group, a domain and a service account are refused — the CLI cannot match one against a caller (F25).

role.description: The role granted, one of the closed set internal/access.Roles returns: viewer, operator, admin.

scope.description: What the role covers: `project`, `all-repos`, or a comma-separated list of canonical repository patterns. A lone `*` is refused — it is `all-repos`, which only a project admin grants (D1583).
